key_moments: Cody Gakpo opened the scoring for the Netherlands in the 72nd minute with an emotional finish.
Issa Diop dramatically equalized for Morocco in the 91st minute with a header, forcing extra time.
Yassine Bounou made a crucial save from Crysencio Summerville's penalty in the shootout.
Ismael Saibari converted the decisive penalty to send Morocco through to the next round.

standout_performers.reason: Made several crucial saves throughout the match and in extra time to keep the Netherlands in contention.
Was the hero of the penalty shootout, making a decisive save to secure Morocco's victory.
A constant attacking threat on the right flank, hitting the post and creating multiple opportunities.

matches.tactical_summary: The Netherlands adopted a more defensive approach with a five-man defense, initially taking the lead through Gakpo but then inviting pressure. Morocco consistently pushed forward, dominating possession in extra time and ultimately finding a late equalizer through persistent attacking.

narrative: Morocco delivered a stunning upset, recovering from a late deficit to force extra time and then prevailing in a dramatic penalty shootout against the Netherlands. This hard-fought victory sends the Atlas Lions into the Round of 16, marking a significant moment of knockout drama.
next_round_notes: No specific injury or card concerns were reported for Morocco heading into their Round of 16 match against Canada.
